draft_en.subject: A second ODM source for the Genie-branded PoE switches that ship with the GHD range
draft_en.body:
Hi Tek,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 28 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the Genie-branded PoE switches that ship with your GHD camera range (E-wind built today, by the look of the housing), a second ODM source in your packaging from small lots, CE/RoHS/UKCA: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $87.4 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 24 x Gigabit PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP, L2+ managed - STC-424DGGPM-280W - $145.7; unmanaged 8 x PoE+ + 2 x uplink - STC-028GP - $27.2. Web GUI with the Genie logo.

One question: which size do your installers order most with the cameras - 8 or 24?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
